status: FINAL - Deep Research station list (matches provisional v0 exactly)
notes: Edit to swap series/stations. Collector reloads on SIGHUP, on mtime change (checked every 60 s) and at least daily; each distinct load is versioned in archive.sqlite config_versions. Removing a series stops polling it; archived rows are never deleted. Required per entry: series_ticker, nws_station, cli_location. Optional: cf6_location, wfo, timezone, lat, lon, climate_day, source.
settlement_note: Kalshi series/event settlement_sources = The Weather Company (weather.com/kalshi); rules_primary names the NWS CLI site (e.g. CLINYC); contract terms GLOBALTEMPERATURE list NWS as Source Agency. The Weather Company page is NOT captured by this archive.

climate_day.definition: midnight-to-midnight LOCAL STANDARD TIME (NWS CLI climate day)
climate_day.note: metadata only; archived data is stored untransformed with source timestamps
